description: Inventory / ad-unit slots selected by Display campaigns for a marketplace over a period, one row per ad-unit (inventory) slot x campaign group: spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPM, program GMV (ad-attributed sales) and ROAS. Source is os_brand_ads_network_level_facts (Display brand ads). Filter by os_client_id (advertiser client) and/or campaign_group_id to scope to specific Display campaigns.

spend.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)
spend.description: Ad spend on this inventory slot for this campaign (fact-table native currency, unconverted per source).

impressions.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.onsite_impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)

clicks.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.clicks ELSE 0 END), 0)

ctr.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.clicks ELSE 0 END) * 100.0, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.onsite_impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)), 2), 0)

cpm.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.cost ELSE 0 END) * 1000, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.onsite_impressions ELSE 0 END), 0)), 4), 0)
cpm.description: Cost per mille = spend / impressions * 1000 for this inventory slot x campaign (fact-table native currency).

program_gmv.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), 0)
program_gmv.description: PROGRAM (ad-attributed, per-click-timestamp) GMV / sales on this inventory slot for this campaign (fact-table native currency).

roas.selector: COALESCE(ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.program_per_click_timestamp_sales ELSE 0 END), NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN baf.cost ELSE 0 END), 0)), 4), 0)

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_brand_ads_network_level_facts AS baf JOIN reporting.campaign_tagging_data AS ctd ON ctd.campaign_id = baf.campaign_id AND ctd.client_id = baf.client_id JOIN reporting.marketing_campaign_group_dimensions AS mcgd ON mcgd.marketing_campaign_group_id = ctd.marketing_campaign_group_id AND mcgd.client_id = ctd.client_id AND mcgd.campaign_origin != 'PACKAGE_BASED' JOIN reporting.brand_ads_dimensions AS bad ON bad.campaign_id = ctd.campaign_id AND baf.ad_id = bad.ad_id AND bad.account_id = ctd.account_id AND baf.ad_creative_id = bad.ad_creative_id AND baf.account_id = bad.account_id AND baf.campaign_id = bad.campaign_id AND baf.client_id = bad.client_id AND baf.marketplace_client_id = bad.marketplace_client_id AND baf.inventory_ad_unit_id = bad.inventory_ad_unit_id JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON baf.marketplace_client_id = mc.client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND baf.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__ ORDER BY __ATTRIBUTES_ORDER_BY__ LIMIT __LIMIT__ OFFSET __OFFSET__;
